items.label: Frame
items.script:
vw = GetFocusedViewport
                  if vw = "A" then
                     FrameSelection false, false, 0
                  elseif vw = "B" then
                     FrameSelection false, false, 1
                  elseif vw = "C" then
                     FrameSelection false, false, 2
                  elseif vw = "D" then
                     FrameSelection false, false, 3
                  end if

items.label: All
items.script:
vw = GetFocusedViewport
                  if vw = "A" then
                     FrameSelection true, false, 0
                  elseif vw = "B" then
                     FrameSelection true, false, 1
                  elseif vw = "C" then
                     FrameSelection true, false, 2
                  elseif vw = "D" then
                     FrameSelection true, false, 3
                  end if

items.label: Reset
items.script:
vw = GetFocusedViewport
                  if vw = "A" then
                     CameraReset 0
                  elseif vw = "B" then
                     CameraReset 1
                  elseif vw = "C" then
                     CameraReset 2
                  elseif vw = "D" then
                     CameraReset 3
                  end if

items.label: Stats
items.script:
oCam = GetViewCamera(-1) & ".camvis."
if GetValue (oCam & "selectioninfo") = True then
	SetValue oCam & "refreshrate," & oCam & "currenttime," & oCam & "selectioninfo," & oCam & "sceneinfo", False
Else
	SetValue oCam & "refreshrate," & oCam & "currenttime," & oCam & "selectioninfo," & oCam & "sceneinfo", True
End if
